name: NSE listed-company directory (OPEN)
note: OPEN. Listed-company directory (name, sector/segment). Verified live: Absa Bank Kenya PLC, Stanbic Holdings Plc, Standard Chartered Bank, Diamond Trust Bank, Sasini Ltd, Williamson Tea, Car & General. Listed announcements + financial results also public; /wp-json/ reachable. Listed only (~60). Real-time market data is a paid product.

name: BRS company search + documents via eCitizen (PAID)
note: PAID. Official registrar. Search + documents (CR12 directors/shareholders, status report, certified extract, annual returns) via eCitizen (login + paid per transaction). Returned 403 to automation. No open bulk/API. Do not bypass login/paywall. Redact CR12 directors/shareholders (Data Protection Act 2019).

name: Kenya Open Data (KODI)
note: National open-data portal. Reachable but no accessible company-register dataset (CKAN/DKAN/Socrata APIs 404). Statistics only.
